title: Grapher election tile-cartogram covered-scopes manifest (frontend-owned)
description: Tiny manifest of which (layout_kind, scope, delim_year) tile-cartogram layouts exist in election_tile_layouts.json, with each layout's tile_count. The frontend reads THIS (not the large layout file) to decide whether to offer the equal-seats toggle for a state, so the toggle never appears for a scope with no tiles. Generated in lockstep with the layout by tools/gen_election_tile_layouts.py.

x-changelog.description: Initial covered-scopes manifest (elections-experience gap-closure plan EGC-C1/C3). One row per shipped layout with its tile_count.

layout_kind.description: Constituency grain: 'ac' = state assembly, 'pc' = Lok Sabha parliamentary.

scope.description: Cartogram scope: a state/UT code (e.g. 'S13') for AC layouts, or 'national' for the all-India PC layout.

delim_year.description: Delimitation vintage the constituency boundaries belong to.

tile_count.description: Number of tiles (constituencies) in this layout.
